faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Key answers regarding procurement rules, tokens, and PFMS payments
faq.q1: How does the automated slot booking work for farmers?
faq.a1: Farmers can select their crop and transport method. If you choose Self Transport, you can directly book any available 30-minute slot at your mandi. If you choose Vehicle Pickup, a nearby vehicle is automatically allocated to your village first, and your slot is scheduled after arrival.
faq.q2: What if a farmer does not have a smartphone or internet access?
faq.a2: The platform provides an 8-Step Offline Assistance module for Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS) officers. Officers enter the farmer’s Aadhaar and crop details, assign a transport trolley, and generate a physical printed token slip with QR code while sending SMS updates to an alternate family contact.
faq.q3: How are DBT payments cleared through PFMS?
faq.a3: Immediately after automated digital weighment and computer-graded moisture analysis, a Gate Pass is created. The Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) payment instruction is sent via the PFMS gateway directly to the farmer’s Aadhaar-linked bank account, crediting funds within 48 to 72 hours.
faq.q4: How can I track the vehicle carrying my crop?
faq.a4: The platform integrates real-time GPS tracking using Leaflet and OSRM routing. Both farmers and mandi officers can view live vehicle markers moving every 10 seconds, check live ETAs, and call the driver directly from the dashboard.
faq.q5: What crops are eligible under MSP procurement?
faq.a5: The system supports all primary kharif and rabi staples including Paddy (Common & Grade A), Wheat (Sharbati & Standard), Maize, Mustard, and Pulses, according to the official state MSP procurement guidelines.
